summary: Correction: the round-2 refinement (98a7dc10b) was documented as 'absent is exactly INVALID_NAMESPACE at connect and INVALID_CLASS at query or first Next', but the classifier granted absent at ANY Next() until 61626edcf (review 5315839933 found the mismatch). The boundary is now enforced: INVALID_CLASS at a Next() reads absent only when no row was returned before it (BoundedQueryResult::rows_before_error); after a returned row it is a fault (unreadable plus a wmi: token).
